input_file.description: Path to the input PDF or image file to be turned into a poster.

output_file.description: Path to the output PDF file containing the split poster pages.

poster_size.description: Target size of the final assembled poster. Can be dimensions like '594mmx841mm' or paper size shorthands like 'A1', 'A0', 'Legal'.

output_paper_size.description: Paper size of the sheets to be printed. Can be dimensions or shorthands like 'A4', 'Letter', 'Tabloid'.

layouter.description: Layout algorithm to use. 'simple' keeps pages upright; 'complex' rotates pages to optimize space.

borders.description: Border sizes for gluing overlap and printer margins. Format: Top:Right:Bottom:Left in mm. Colon-separated.

page_number.description: Page number of the input PDF to use as the source for the poster.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging output to stderr.

use_gui.description: Run the application in GUI mode (tkinter). Set to false for CLI/daemonized usage.

remove_alpha.description: Remove alpha channel from input raster images. Makes PDF not lossless but compatible with img2pdf.

cover_page.description: Add a cover page showing the final layout arrangement.

cutting_guides.description: Print dashed lines to indicate where to cut individual pages.

page_numbers.description: Print page numbers on the output sheets.

poster_border.description: Print a dashed border around the entire poster outline for accurate cutting.
